<!-- Generated by scripts/api-reference.mjs from src/data/openapi.json: do not edit, run `task refs`. -->

- `POST /api/v1/auth/code` — Email a sign-in code (replaces any earlier one)
- `POST /api/v1/auth/verify` — Exchange an emailed code for a session (creates the account the first time)
- `GET /api/v1/auth/providers` — Social sign-in providers, and which are configured
- `POST /api/v1/auth/oauth/{provider}/start` — Begin a social sign-in: where to send the browser
- `POST /api/v1/auth/oauth/{provider}/callback` — Finish a social sign-in (creates the account the first time)
- `GET /api/v1/auth/me` — The signed-in account
- `PATCH /api/v1/auth/me` — Change the signed-in account's own details (its alias)
- `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` — End this session

## Email a sign-in code (replaces any earlier one)

`POST /api/v1/auth/code` · public

**Body** (`application/json`): [CodeRequest](/reference/api/schemas/#coderequest)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | string (email) |  |
| `locale` *(optional)* | `en`, `es` | default `"en"` |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 202 | any |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |
| 429 | [`too_many_codes`](/reference/errors/#too_many_codes): too soon after the last one, or too many for the address; [`too_many_attempts`](/reference/errors/#too_many_attempts): the address is locked by wrong codes; [`too_many_requests`](/reference/errors/#too_many_requests): too many from the network address (`Retry-After`) |
| 503 | [`mail_unavailable`](/reference/errors/#mail_unavailable) |

## Exchange an emailed code for a session (creates the account the first time)

`POST /api/v1/auth/verify` · public

**Body** (`application/json`): [CodeCheck](/reference/api/schemas/#codecheck)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | string (email) |  |
| `code` | string | pattern `^\d{6}$` |
| `locale` *(optional)* | `en`, `es` | default `"en"` |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [SignedIn](/reference/api/schemas/#signedin) |
| 401 | [`invalid_code`](/reference/errors/#invalid_code): wrong or expired |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |
| 429 | [`too_many_attempts`](/reference/errors/#too_many_attempts): this code, or the address for a while (`Retry-After`); [`too_many_requests`](/reference/errors/#too_many_requests): the network address |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |

## Begin a social sign-in: where to send the browser

`POST /api/v1/auth/oauth/{provider}/start` · public

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | path | string |  |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [OAuthStart](/reference/api/schemas/#oauthstart) |
| 404 | [`unknown_provider`](/reference/errors/#unknown_provider) |
| 409 | [`provider_disabled`](/reference/errors/#provider_disabled): not configured |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |

## Finish a social sign-in (creates the account the first time)

`POST /api/v1/auth/oauth/{provider}/callback` · public

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | path | string |  |

**Body** (`application/json`): [OAuthCallback](/reference/api/schemas/#oauthcallback)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | string | min length 1, max length 2048 |
| `state` | string | min length 1, max length 256 |
| `locale` *(optional)* | `en`, `es` | default `"en"` |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [SignedIn](/reference/api/schemas/#signedin) |
| 400 | [`invalid_state`](/reference/errors/#invalid_state): unknown, used or expired |
| 403 | [`email_unverified`](/reference/errors/#email_unverified): the provider does not vouch for an email |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |
| 502 | [`provider_error`](/reference/errors/#provider_error) |
